title: Add Lazy Client-Side Pyodide Runtime to MemorySmith Markdown Enhancements
description: Implement browser-side Pyodide execution with one-time lazy loader and per-cell execution wiring inside existing UI scripts. Extend memorySmith.markdown.renderEnhancements and static asset loading in MemorySmith.App (App.razor plus wwwroot scripts) so py-cell elements are hydrated only when present. Wire this behavior to a combined markdown runtime settings model shared with Mermaid. Runtime source should default to CDN with SRI, feature flags must default disabled so admins can set policies before enabling user-visible execution, and Viewer-role users must not be able to execute code blocks.
